content: Beta-defensin 103 is a protein encoded by the DEFB103A gene in humans. Defensins are a group of peptides with microbicidal and cytotoxic properties, primarily produced by neutrophils. Members of the defensin family share a high degree of similarity in their protein sequences. The protein encoded by the DEFB103A gene, defensin beta 103B, exhibits broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity and is believed to play a critical role in the innate immune defense of epithelial tissues. In dogs, the product of the corresponding genetic locus, β-Defensin 103, not only contributes to antimicrobial defense but also influences pigmentation by acting as an agonist of the melanocortin 1 receptor.
